$schema.description: Path to this schema, relative to the configuration file.

externals.description: Modules supplied by the consuming application rather than this bundle.

forbiddenPackages.description: Package names or scoped package globs that must not survive tree shaking.

fixtures.description: Fixtures to verify, keyed by path relative to fixturesRoot using forward slashes. A fixture present in fixturesRoot but absent here is skipped, which is how a directory shared with monosize is narrowed to the entry points that carry an isolation guarantee.

forbiddenPackages.description: Replaces the top-level list for this fixture. Narrowing has to be possible, so this overrides rather than extends.

allowedViolations.description: Forbidden packages tolerated as tracked debt for this fixture.

items.description: Exact resolved package name. Globs are rejected so a tolerated leak cannot silently cover a new one.
